name: Aguni ~Unmei no Saki~
source: In this world, there are those who have transcendent powers, able to accomplish supernatural feats. Most people have this to some degree, the truly powerful rising to belong to the elite. Those without these capabilities are looked down upon by society as lower class and treated as inferior, lower than human. The story revolves around the new sovereign seeking to crush a group with revolutionary ideas.
translation: 这个世界上，有些人拥有超越常理的力量，能够完成种种超自然之举。大多数人都或多或少具备这种能力，而真正强大者会跻身精英阶层。没有能力的人则被社会视为下等阶级，遭到歧视，甚至被当成比人类更低等的存在。故事围绕新任统治者展开，他试图粉碎一个抱持革命思想的团体。
